clue.text: Building perhaps something that is contrived

clue.text: The doctrine that's a religious belief

parts.note: an ism is any doctrine or system of belief

clue.text: Unversed? Unimaginative

definitions.meaning: read cryptically, not in verse, that is written in prose

clue.text: Like a tired kangaroo beyond the pale

definitions.meaning: a worn-out kangaroo has run out of hops or leaps

explanation.definitionFit: Literally a kangaroo with no jumps left; idiomatically something off limits or unacceptable.

clue.text: However, too much of this in food could made us flabby

definitions.text: However, too much of this in food could made us flabby

parts.words: However, too much of this in food could made us flabby
parts.note: the surface warns of a carbohydrate found in bread and potatoes, also the stiffening used on shirt collars that makes cloth anything but flabby

explanation.surface: A dietary warning that too much of some foodstuff will leave us out of shape.

explanation.definitionFit: A carbohydrate in potatoes and grains, eaten in excess, adds weight; it also stiffens laundry.

clue.text: The artist to draw the old explorer?

parts.note: a drawn match is a tie

explanation.surface: A question about a painter being asked to sketch a famous explorer.

clue.text: Others house elderly here

parts.note: the rest means the others, the remainder
a house is a home

explanation.definitionFit: A residential institution where retired or infirm people live and are cared for.

clue.text: Precipitately dolichocephalic!

a technical term meaning having a long skull, read here as a phrase describing the skull's length

explanation.definitionFit: Rushing recklessly is one sense; split in two it describes a long skull, what dolichocephalic means.

clue.text: One of a number used to see what one is eating?

definitions.text: One of a number used to see what one is eating?

parts.words: One of a number used to see what one is eating
parts.note: a pointed canine in the upper jaw, whose name joins the organ of sight to a biting part, as if it could watch the food

explanation.surface: A whimsical question about which body part lets you watch your food.
explanation.definitionFit: An upper canine is called so because its root lies just below the eye.

clue.text: Hostess on stage I shamelessly included

indicators.note: the letters are included within the words on stage I shamelessly, running across them

clue.text: Stick on female side

the maternal branch of a family

clue.text: Of age

parts.note: not grown up but relating to an era, a historical age

clue.text: Lean against eccentric from beccles

explanation.definitionFit: Beccles lies in Suffolk, so a native belongs to that eastern English region.

clue.text: Angry toxophilite?

clue.text: Little cook's view of those who are less important

parts.note: little means small
to fry is to cook in fat

explanation.definitionFit: Insignificant people, from the term for young fish too tiny to matter.

clue.text: Interpretation was, say, going over egghead and little sister

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece for 'say' sits above the one for 'egghead'

parts.note: ex means former, what was
e.g. means for example, as 'say' does
the head, or first letter, of egg is E
sis is short for sister

clue.text: Rippling effect produced by sea in north America?

clue.text: Credit note in place of rent

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
E is a musical note

explanation.definitionFit: A rent is a split or tear, and a crevice is a narrow crack or fissure.

clue.text: Copy of legal record a tester translated

explanation.definitionFit: In law an estreat is a true extract or copy of a court record, used to enforce fines.

clue.text: No end of fungal plant on eastern fruit

parts.note: a lichen is a composite plant of fungus and alga

clue.text: More oblique joint holder

a pin pushed through a joint of meat to hold it for roasting
